name: norma43-mcp
description: Extractos bancarios Norma 43 (AEB43/CSB43) a JSON/CSV y conciliación bancaria determinista. Validación de IBAN, NIF y SEPA.
long_description: Lee extractos Cuaderno 43 de cualquier banco español, los convierte a JSON o CSV, concilia movimientos con facturas o cobros esperados y valida IBAN, NIF/CIF e identificador de acreedor SEPA. Pago por uso con créditos KeyFlint; la validación de identificadores es gratis.

tools.name: parse_norma43
tools.description: Read a Spanish Norma 43 (Cuaderno 43 / AEB43 / CSB43) bank statement into structured JSON.

tools.name: norma43_to_csv
tools.description: Convert a Norma 43 statement to CSV (one row per movement, with IBAN, running balance and concept names).

tools.name: reconcile_movements
tools.description: Bank reconciliation (conciliación bancaria): match bank movements to expected items, deterministically.

tools.name: validate_identifier
tools.description: Validate a Spanish/EU banking identifier. Free.

tools.name: sepa_creditor_id
tools.description: Compute the Spanish SEPA creditor identifier (AT-02, 'identificador de acreedor') from a NIF. Free.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Credit price of each tool and where to buy credits. Free.

tools.name: credits_balance
tools.description: Remaining credits on your KeyFlint license. Free.
